nisar_status.reason: NISAR L2 GCOV science products require NASA Earthdata Login credentials with ASF EULA acceptance. Metadata and same-geometry pre/post pairs were discovered via NASA CMR, and unauthenticated download attempts were empirically verified as blocked (HTTP 401).

sensor_input: Sentinel-1 RTC C-band (VV/VH), 20 m, Microsoft Planetary Computer

reference_labels.definition: Sentinel-2 L2A dNBR >= 0.11 over SCL land-valid classes {4,5,7} (water SCL=6 excluded) and Sentinel-1 valid pixels; USGS moderate-severity dNBR >= 0.27 also evaluated
reference_labels.independent_check: NASA MODIS MCD64A1.061 burned area (500 m, QA Bits 0=1, 1=1, 2=0 filtered)
reference_labels.scientific_disclaimer: Neither Sentinel-2 dNBR nor MODIS MCD64A1 nor FIRMS hotspots is pixel-level ground truth. dNBR (20 m) and MCD64A1 (500 m) are independent satellite reference products evaluated on separate leaderboards.

scientific_limitations: Only one wildfire event (CA_GANN_2026) contributed to supervised model training.
Only one wildfire event (CA_DOME_2026) was used for validation and threshold selection.
Only one wildfire event (CA_BUG_2026) was held out for testing; single-event test performance does not establish multi-event generalization.
CA_TIMBER_2026 was excluded from supervised training due to inverted C-band VH backscatter physics (ROC-AUC 0.4876) and coastal complex overlap.
Zero NISAR L-band pixels were used; all SAR model inputs are Sentinel-1A C-band (5.405 GHz) RTC.
